settings.description: Keep a copy of your data in a folder on this computer, updated automatically whenever you make a change. Put the folder in iCloud Drive, Dropbox or Google Drive to have your data on your other computers too. The files are not encrypted: anyone who can open the folder can read them.
settings.chooseFolderDescription: Pick an empty folder, or the folder you already back up to from another computer.
settings.unsupported: This browser cannot save to a folder on your disk. Automatic backup works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and Opera; here, use Export to file above.
settings.connectedTo: Backing up to the folder “{folder}” as “{computer}”.
settings.disconnectDescription: The folder and its files stay where they are; you can connect again at any time.
settings.needsPermission: Your browser needs your permission to use the backup folder again. Backups are paused until then.
settings.conflict: Your data here and the backup saved by “{computer}” on {time} both changed since this computer last backed up. Choose which one to keep.
settings.keepLocal: Keep the data on this computer
settings.useRemote: Use the backup from the folder
settings.replaceWarning: This replaces the data on this computer with the backup from the folder. A copy of this computer's data is saved in the folder first, as a file whose name contains “before-replace”; you can open it later with Import from file.
settings.failed: The last backup attempt failed. Kalkul will try again automatically.
settings.error: Something went wrong with the backup folder. Please try again.
settings.folderMissing: The backup folder “{folder}” can't be found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted. Backups are paused.

nameDialog.title: Name this computer
nameDialog.description: Kalkul will keep this computer in sync with the backup folder.
nameDialog.label: Name for this computer
nameDialog.hint: Shown in the backup file names, so you can tell which computer saved what.

settings.fork: The backup folder holds two versions that were saved separately on different computers. Choose which one to use on this computer; the other stays in the folder's history.
settings.unreadable: The backup saved by “{computer}” on {time} can't be opened by this version of Kalkul, probably because it was saved by a newer one. Reload the page to get the latest Kalkul. Nothing on this computer has been changed.

drop.hint: Drop your backup folder instead to keep this computer in sync with it.
drop.alreadyConnected: A backup folder is already connected. You can change it in Settings → Automatic backup.
drop.unsupported: This browser cannot keep a folder in sync. Drop a single backup file to import it, or use Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc or Opera for automatic backup.

landing.hint: Already using Kalkul on another computer? Drop your backup folder anywhere on this page.
landing.empty: Connected to the folder “{folder}”. It holds no Kalkul data yet, so there is nothing to load here; whatever you enter from now on is backed up to it.
landing.attention: Connected to the folder “{folder}”, but it needs your attention before anything can load.
